title: Consumed target grammar mismatch bypasses unknown-year calendar guard
impact: Unmocked isolated StateStore append advanced seq0 to1 and persisted an ordinary T+1 opening plan with an unknown-2027 target. No broker execution or production-runtime write was performed. Normal live provider producing such identifiers was not proven.
root_cause: Calendar parser used ASCII fullmatch and silently ignored unmatched consumed strings, while downstream IM target syntax used Unicode digits or optional decimal strikes.
repair: Actual consumed target syntax must be recognized or explicitly rejected; unselected diagnostic contract text remains ignored.
